title: Execution Request
description: Formal request to the Execution Engine. Specifies which changeset to execute, in which mode, and under what environment constraints.

changeset_ref.description: The changeset_id from the approved proposed-changeset.

execution_mode.description: dry-run: simulate only. sandbox: execute in isolated workspace. apply: execute against real codebase (requires prior evidence).

approved_by.description: Actor signature or Kernel decision ID that authorized this execution.
